title.en: Action Budgets, Iteration Caps, and Cost Governors

hook: A mid-sized e-commerce agent's monthly LLM cost jumped from $1,200 to $4,800 after its team enabled the "order-tracking" skill. That is not a pricing bug. That is an agent that found a new loop and kept spending inside it. Microsoft's Agent Governance Toolkit (April 2, 2026) codifies the defense against this class: per-request `max_tokens`, per-task token and dollar budgets, per-day/month caps, iteration caps, tiered model routing, prompt caching, context windowing, HITL checkpoints on expensive actions, kill switches on budget breach. Anthropic's Claude Code Agent SDK ships the same primitives under different names. Financial velocity limits — e.g. cut access on >$50 in 10 minutes — catch loops faster than monthly caps.
